title: Coherent geometric object isomorphisms for specified affine models
statement: Let I be a directed preorder, R:I→CommRing a diagram, c a colimiting cocone, and i∈I. Let Y be affine [def-pc-scheme], s:Y→Spec R(i), and assume scheme derived categories with Hom universe w [def-pc-derived-category]. Set B=Γ(Y). Supply t:Spec B≅Y and a derived equivalence e:D(O_Spec B)≌D(O_Y), with a localization isomorphism he:Q⋙e.functor≅(termwise pushforward along t.hom)⋙Q [lem-pc-scheme-iso-derived-equivalence]. Let P,Q∈D(O_Y), let E₀,K₀ be bounded complexes of finite projective B-modules, and supply hPE:e.inverse(P)≅Q(tilde E₀) and hQK:e.inverse(Q)≅Q(tilde K₀). Form the explicit F,r of [def-pc-affine-base-change-ring-diagram] and E=r*E₀,K=r*K₀. For j in the nested tail put E_j=F(i)→F(j) scalar extension of E and K_j similarly; put E_∞,K_∞ for their scalar extensions to colimit F. There exist equivalences d_j:D(O_Spec F(j))≌D(O_(Y×_Spec R(i) Spec R(j))) and d_∞:D(O_Spec colimit F)≌D(O_(Y×_Spec R(i) Spec c.pt)), and object isomorphisms αE_j:d_j(Q(tilde E_j))≅pullback_j P, αK_j:d_j(Q(tilde K_j))≅pullback_j Q, βE:d_∞(Q(tilde E_∞))≅pullback_∞ P, βK:d_∞(Q(tilde K_∞))≅pullback_∞ Q. Define the sheafified chain-map expressions C_j(f)=αE_j.inv ≫ d_j.map(Q.map(tilde.map f)) ≫ αK_j.hom and C_∞(g)=βE.inv ≫ d_∞.map(Q.map(tilde.map g)) ≫ βK.hom. For every chain map f:E_j→K_j and j≤k, C_k(scalarExtensionHom(j,k,f))=perfectStageMap(R,s,j,k)(C_j(f)). Also C_∞(scalarExtensionHom(j,∞,f))=perfectLimitMap(R,c,s,j)(C_j(f)), with scalarExtensionHom and the pinned geometric maps exactly as in [def-pc-complex-scalar-extension-hom] and [lem-pc-perfect-hom-transport]. There is no choice of module-derived categories and no assertion of module-derived Hom equivalence in this statement.

For each σ(j) use exists_scheme_iso_derived_equivalence and select its localization comparison in this proposition proof. Apply the same proved theorem to τ to obtain dlim and its localization comparison. No data-valued definition chooses witnesses.

Extract the upper support bound and convert termwise projectivity to categorical flatness. Apply the proved upstream CochainComplex.kFlat_of_isStrictlyLE_of_flat directly, obtaining the existing native K-flat predicate. This is the private proved helper boundedProjective_isKFlat; no duplicate K-flat definition is introduced.

Use the specified F,r,C,E,K unchanged. Apply exists_affineBaseChangeModelIsosOfSchemeComparisons to the compatible scheme identifications and fixed localized derived transports, with native K-flatness and the reflexive equalities defining E and K. Keep the conclusion folded as the existing affineModelComparisonData proposition; no copy of its large existential body is unfolded in the item.

theorem exists_affineBaseChangeModelComparisonIsos
    {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)]
    (R : I ⥤ CommRingCat.{u}) (c : Cocone R) (hc : IsColimit c)
    (i : I) (Y : Scheme.{u}) [IsAffine Y] (s : Y ⟶ Spec (R.obj i))
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    (t : Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) ≅ Y)
    (e : schemeDerivedCategory (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))) ≌ schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (he : DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ e.functor ≅
      (@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) _ _ _ _
        (SheafOfModules.pushforward t.hom.toRingCatSheafHom)
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ rfl⟩ (ComplexShape.up ℤ)) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Q)
    (P Q : schemeDerivedCategory Y)
    (E₀ K₀ : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))) ℤ)
    (hE : (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (E₀.X n)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) (E₀.X n) ∧
        Module.Projective (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) (E₀.X n))
    (hK : (∃ a b : ℤ, ∀ n : ℤ, n < a ∨ b < n → IsZero (K₀.X n)) ∧
      ∀ n : ℤ, Module.Finite (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) (K₀.X n) ∧
        Module.Projective (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) (K₀.X n))
    (hPE : e.inverse.obj P ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (@id (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) ⥤
                  SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
                  (tilde.functor (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj E₀))
    (hQK : e.inverse.obj Q ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj
      ((@Functor.mapHomologicalComplex ℤ (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)))
        (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
        _ _ _ _ (@id (ModuleCat.{u} (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y)) ⥤
                  SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (Spec (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))).toRingedSpace))
                  (tilde.functor (Scheme.Γ.obj (.op Y))))
        ⟨fun _ _ ↦ tilde.map_zero⟩ (.up ℤ)).obj K₀)) :
    let F := affineBaseChangeRingDiagram R i Y s t
    let r := affineBaseChangeInitialMap R i Y s t
    let E := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj E₀
    let K := ((ModuleCat.extendScalars r).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K₀
    affineModelComparisonData R c i Y s P Q F (colimit.cocone F) E K
